notes.title: Update 1.1.0 Christmas
notes.content:
[h2]Hello hunters![/h2]

Here is our Christmas Update!
We didn't add anything crazy, but we still came pretty far since our 1.0 so I guess we can call this a 1.1.0 update.

[h3]Christmas Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a new UFO and event
[*] New decorations
[*] 2 new items in the shop
[*] Christmas can be disabled in the game settings
[/list]
[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Interacting with the computer forum opens Steam discussion and screenshots page
[/list]
[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*]You now start the game with $75
[/list]

Merry Christmas Season!

[b]Cheers,[/b]
Abtin

notes.title: Update 1.0.2 Live Now!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello hunters![/h2]

Finally! After months we have a new update for you. 
We are fixing and changing the game based on your feedback. Thank you for your support!

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated the Discord Link
[*] UFOs won't be taking you to the ocean anymore
[*] The delivery robot won't give out flashlights anymore (it's a WIP, sorry!)
[/list]
[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added lots of new UFOs
[*] Reworked the UFO spawn system.
[*] New events! Unique UFOs should now spawn in key locations such as the lighthouse
[*] Two additional in-game tips to guide the player through the main controls and objective of the game
[/list]
[h3]Balancing[/h3]
[list]
[*]The abducers now spawn less frequently
[/list]
Also, devlog will resume shortly. We have a small roadmap of updates incoming (starting with a [b]Christmas [/b]themed one!)

As always feedback and bug reports are very appreciated!

[b]Cheers,[/b]
Abtin

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
[h2]Hello hunters![/h2]

Although small, finally the first update of the game is here.
As announced, we have added [b]achievements[/b]. For now there are 9 of them.

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the delivery robot getting stuck and giving infinite loot
[*] Fixed translation errors in the UFO Collection
[/list]
[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added achievements
[*] Added the ability to remove items from the shopping cart with mouse right-click (only in the first shop for now)
[/list]
[h3]Balancing[/h3]
We changed how much money you gain when selling photos. We felt like it was way too high and after the first UFO it wasn't a survival game anymore! Let us know how it feels.


As always feedback and bug reports are very appreciated!

[b]Cheers,[/b]
Abtin

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.content:
[h3]Hello hunters![/h3]

It's been a week since our [b]1.0 release[/b], and I'd like to thank you all again for supporting the game!

Currently we are working on [b]bug fixes[/b], that will be soon released in our next update,[b] version 1.0.1[/b].
We also heard your feedback on current mechanics, and will work out a plan to improve them.
Some of the demo achievements are also [b]coming soon[/b].

[h3]Stay tuned![/h3]

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.9.5
notes.content:
Hello guys,

We did some QOL changes and improvements.


[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the game breaking robot delivery bug, where you couldn't refuse or accept with mouse (still could with arrow keys and Enter).
[*] The lockpick now correctly costs $1500 instead of just $350.
[*] Some UFOs weren't worth any money, we have been tackling that issue and now every UFO you see should be worth something.
[*] Delivery robot should be stuck less
[/list]

[h3]New features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added saving during pee animation
[*] Added "Submit a bug" button
[*] Added saving animation
[*] When you are thirsty, you are not slowed anymore but you can't run
[/list]

[h3]Known issues[/h3]
[list]
[strike][*] Submit a bug doesn't redirect correctly to the Steam discussions
[*] When you unpause the game, you look in a different, arbitrary direction than the one you paused in
[*] Saving animation feature is not complete so it has some issues like looping when you save too many times when pressing pause[/strike]
[/list]

Happy hunting!

Abtin

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.9.4
notes.content:
Hello guys,

We did some QOL changes and improvements.

[h2][b]IMPORTANT[/b][/h2]
We solved some issues with the saving system, [b]so your save file will be reset[/b].

[h3]Changes [/h3]
[list]
[*] Lowered base mouse sensitivity
[*] More forgiving hunger and thirst bars
[*] Default graphics option changed to "standard", from "psx"
[*] Added an 'X' to quit from the computer desktop
[*] Fixed Main menu navigation with controller
[/list]
[h3]New features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Allison should bark when spotting an UFO
[*] New game icon
[*] Clearer instructions, also added a poster in the bathroom that teaches how to develop photos.
[/list]

Known issues

Happy hunting!

Abtin

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.9.3
notes.content:
Hello guys,

This new demo patch addressed some issues.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]

[*] Fixed some issues with the status bars

[*] Fixed some sounds not being present, like the photo printing sound
[/list]

Happy hunting!

Abtin
